storyTitle: Sensex and Nifty shrug off a gap-down open to close at nine-month highs on bank and IT buying
insight: Nvidia's 14% crash erased the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, yet India closed at nine-month highs: the AI trade cracked, the money moved.
linkedin:
The Nasdaq lost its entire 2026 gain in one day. India closed at a nine-month high.

Nvidia fell 14% on a reported SEC probe into its disclosures, the S&P 500 and Dow entered correction, and Nikkei and Kospi each slid over 4%.

Yet the Nifty recovered more than 460 points from its open to close at 25,800.60, led by Nifty Bank up 2.49% and Nifty IT up 1.30%.

When the AI trade cracks, capital doesn't vanish. It rotates, and today it rotated into Indian banks and IT.

leaders.title: The Quote Is Not the Thinker
leaders.post:
Most famous philosophy quotes mislead, even the real ones.

The Dostoevsky line about finding something to live for is spoken by the Grand Inquisitor, a villain arguing that people should be relieved of their freedom.

Another is Raskolnikov defending the theory Crime and Punishment spends its length demolishing, as Joe Foley of Unsolicited Advice shows.

The fix: read the paragraph around a quote, or paraphrase and don't attribute. You can borrow an idea freely, but never put your meaning in a dead person's mouth.
